opening.argument: The video shows a practical design lesson: the speaker teaches viewers to make Canva social-media graphics and offer that work through Fiverr. The restaurant-post example and the visible Canva design keep the focus on the work being taught. The earnings figures are framed as calculations from service prices and a conditional estimate of posts completed in an hour, not as guaranteed payments or completed transactions. The description expressly disclaims guaranteed results, and the speaker says results vary with skills and application. Taken together, the observable instruction and those qualifications support an educational purpose.
